2.9" TFT reflective screen with integrated screen light, 240x160 resolution, 40.8mm x 61.2mm screen size

sources.method: width = 25.4*D*a/sqrt(a^2+b^2), height = 25.4*D*b/sqrt(a^2+b^2), Decimal half-up to 0.1 mm, using D=2.9 in and resolution_px=240:160 from Nintendo UK Technical Details Screen row <https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Hardware/Nintendo-History/Game-Boy-Advance-SP/Game-Boy-Advance-SP-627141.html>. Square pixels and exact published diagonal assumed, although the maker rounds the diagonal. Existing hyperobjects_reference.check.active_area law gives 61.3 x 40.9 mm. Nintendo separately prints an unlabeled 40.8mm x 61.2mm screen-size pair; that raw pair is preserved in notes rather than assigned axes or forced to equal the rounded-diagonal derivation.

notes: Single-screen clamshell: secondary display absent. Closed.width is Nintendo 縦84.6 and closed.height is the hinge axis 横82, matching the existing clamshell family convention. Open dimensions are unresolved.

Display coverage: Nintendo UK Technical Details enumerates one Screen entry; the displays list is covered as complete by that row, so no secondary display is listed. This sources the original frontlit SP only; no AGS-101 fact is borrowed. The page prints 40.8mm x 61.2mm without axis labels. That pair stays raw here; active_area_mm instead follows the existing diagonal-plus-resolution law with stated square-pixel/rounded-diagonal assumptions, giving 61.3 x 40.9 mm. The difference is precision, not silently reconciled.
